title: Read one lawless system around our space whole: deposits, creatures, stations, order books, mission boards
note: Kept by Oracle (orders F13). Since 2026-11-15 21:50 UTC, on Suggi's word, every division and the whole command group fly it: it stands in every plan before `park`. The list: the 27 systems within two jumps of our border, nearest first, then Atlas and Intercrus, LHS 1140 beside Antares for its station (Trade, requests.log ENT-045); since 2026-11-15 23:40 UTC the third ring from our border (the 10 lawless systems of it not yet listed, from game/map/galaxy.tsv) and Goldcrest and Bluerift of the fourth for the stations of the Ironlight Combine (governance/map.md, section 5). GSC-0016 lies one lane from the pirate stronghold Gliese 581 (governance/map.md, section 4). Every system on the list is lawless (police 0) and none is a stronghold. A system where a ship of ours was lost leaves the list until Military has looked at it. No goods of value in the hold on the way out: `requires.empty_hold` since 2026-11-15 23:40 UTC (orders F13).
